newsitem.title: FRANCE: GE Capital French firms set car credit unit.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital French firms set car credit unit.

text.p: French finance house Sovac and Credit de l'Est, two General Electric Capital units, on Monday launched a company specialising in financing for car dealers called Gefiservices.

The head of Gefiservices, Jean-Pierre Wolf, said in a statement the company was created from the merger of Sovac's Cavia network and Credit de l'Est and aimed to offer a global service which took into account the specific needs of car dealers. It plans to become one of the sector leaders in the next few years.
GE Capital is the finance unit of General Electric Co.
